text:
Megan: Quick pre-launch sync for the benchmarks hub next week. Need to finalize keywords, schema, internal linking plan, and a redirects list for legacy posts.
Alex: Added a refreshed seed keyword list: 'LLM inference cost', 'low-latency LLM serving', 'inference batching best practices'. Spreadsheet link in a sec.
Sophia: Share the sheet so I can group semantic clusters and map pillar topics.
Alex: https://docs.google.com/xyz  (see tab 'benchmarks'). I've added search volumes + intent tags.
Tom: For structured data, recommend Article + FAQ on landing, SoftwareApplication/Product on feature pages, and Event schema with potentialAction for the webinar landing. Consider DataDownload for the CSV.
Megan: Good. Tom, can you draft the JSON-LD snippets we can paste into the CMS?
Tom: Sure. Example FAQ snippet incoming.
Tom: ```json
{\n  "@context": "https://schema.org",\n  "@type": "FAQPage",\n  "mainEntity": [\n    {"@type": "Question","name": "How do you measure LLM inference cost?","acceptedAnswer": {"@type": "Answer","text": "We compute TCO per 1M tokens using throughput profiles across GPU families and amortized infra costs."}}\n  ]\n}\n```
Sophia: Looks good. Add 'sameAs' linking to the benchmark methodology repo and include a DataDownload object for the CSV dataset.
Megan: Redirects: we have ~12 legacy posts to consolidate. I sketched a redirect map; eng needs to implement 301s and preserve UTM params. Also want an 'x-redirect-source' header for tracking.
Alex: Compact redirect list below; we'll canonicalize to hub pages.
SEOBot: Redirect validator: 12 entries, 0 conflicts detected.
Alex: ```
# old_path,new_path,reason
/blog/llm-cost-v1,/benchmarks/llm-inference-cost,consolidate
/blog/kv-cache-guide,/benchmarks/kv-cache,merge
/product/old-routing-guide,/docs/routing-policy,redirect
/blog/low-latency-tips,/benchmarks/latency,merge
/blog/quantization-explained,/benchmarks/quantization,canonicalize
/blog/old-embed-guide,/benchmarks/embeddings,consolidate
/blog/model-selection-tips,/benchmarks/model-selection,merge
/blog/onnx-optimizations,/benchmarks/onnx,redirect
/blog/legacy-benchmark-2019,/benchmarks/archive,archive-redirect
/blog/serve-best-practices,/benchmarks/serving,merge
/blog/old-gpu-compare,/benchmarks/gpu-comparison,consolidate
/blog/deprecated-qa,/benchmarks/faq,redirect
```
Megan: Two asks for eng: (1) apply 301 redirects in deploy, preserving query strings; (2) add response header 'x-redirect-source' with the original path.
Alex: I'll open a Jira ticket and tag infra.
Sophia: Internal linking plan: hub landing -> benchmark pages -> webinar landing -> docs. Add contextual CTAs for webinar signup and CSV download. Also embed structuredData potentialAction on webinar page for Event signups.
Tom: For monitoring, add GA4 event for redirect hits and pipe x-redirect-source into Logstash. I'll coordinate with SRE.
Megan: Draft for the launch post: short hero, methodology section, top findings, CTA to webinar and an interactive cost calculator. I'll share the draft by EOD.
Alex: SEO pre-publish checklist: 1) meta titles include the primary keyword, 2) canonical tags, 3) structured data validated, 4) redirects applied in staging and smoke-tested, 5) internal links added, 6) sitemap updated + robots.txt reviewed, 7) monitor Search Console for crawl errors.
Sophia: I'll run a Screaming Frog crawl after the staging deploy.
Megan: Schedule: staging deploy tomorrow 09:00 PT, go/no-go review 13:00 PT, prod deploy Wed 02:00 PT.
Tom: Also added a Lighthouse perf task: optimize hero images, lazy-load charts.
Alex: hreflang not required for US-first launch, but note for APAC follow-up.
SEOBot: Reminder: run Google Rich Results test after deploy: https://search.google.com/test/rich-results
Megan: Any blockers?
Sophia: None from content.
Tom: No blockers.
Alex: Jira ticket: created and assigned to infra for redirects.
Megan: Thanks team. Closing thread. :tada:
